title: Motion (Nazarian – McOsker, et al.) relative to a Citywide Vacant and Public Nuisance Property Abatement Program to identify, prioritize, secure, clean,…
text:
[Council File 26-1280]
Motion (Nazarian – McOsker, et al.) relative to a Citywide Vacant and Public Nuisance Property Abatement Program to identify, prioritize, secure, clean, repair, demolish, or otherwise abate vacant and nuisance properties that pose significant threats to public safety and quality of life, and related matters.
(This item was referred to the Public Works Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Establishing a Citywide Vacant and Public Nuisance Property Abatement Program to identify, prioritize, secure, clean, repair, demolish, or otherwise abate vacant and nuisance properties.
